title: Cleverbridge payment card breach, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Cleverbridge, BleepingComputer, The Register, Malwarebytes, Red Hat, SUSE, Tenable, Veeam, Jamf, Sony, Parallels, Plesk or any other company, news outlet, government agency, or anyone else named.
size_basis: A payment platform used by many software sellers. No count of affected cards is published; one seller says a small subset of its customers were hit.
who_is_affected: People who paid for software through Cleverbridge and got a notice. Check card statements, tell the card issuer about unknown charges, and ask whether a new card is needed.

known.text: A third party copied payment card data stored on Cleverbridge's platform.
Cleverbridge detected the activity on Nov 4 and had systems back online that day.
Cleverbridge began notifying affected people on Nov 20.
The company says it was not ransomware: no systems were encrypted.

not_known.text: Exactly which card details were taken; notices differ on whether the CVV/CVC or contact details were copied.
